description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
summary: PageIndex builds a hierarchical tree index over a document and lets an LLM reason its way down that tree to find the relevant section, which is a much more honest retrieval primitive than "top-k nearest embeddings" for long technical reports. The local SDK mode is the part I care about: pip install, point it at your own model key, and you get traceable, explainable retrieval without standing up a vector DB or spending a week tuning chunking strategies. In my bioinformatics work, where the documents are 200-page regulatory filings and the question is "what does section 4.2.3 actually say about the exclusion criteria," this beats vector RAG because the model is literally navigating the document structure the way I would.
